turns.question: It's the end of 7 October 2026. How many customers who signed up in 2026 have never placed an order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for customers who signed up in 2026 and have never placed an order, so I can't give that figure. The closest metrics are Signups, which counts 20 customers who signed up from 1 January to 7 October 2026 (customers), and Signup-to-first-order rate, which measures only first orders placed within 30 days of signing up.
